items.title: Ohio's first statewide early-voting tally: 228,470 ballots cast
items.summary: Ohio Secretary of State Frank LaRose's office released the first statewide early-voting total for the Nov 3 general, compiled from daily reports by all 88 county boards: 228,470 ballots — 194,841 in-person early + 33,629 absentee returned. In-person dominates the mix so far; early in-person voting began Oct 6 and runs through Nov 1. OhioSoS.gov dashboard tracks statewide/county trends. Single-sourced (SoS data via one outlet; no second outlet yet).
items.source_name: New Americans Magazine (quoting Ohio Secretary of State's office)

items.title: NewsNation/DDHQ finding: independents lean Democratic, but only 35% have made up their minds
items.summary: New finding from the already-timeline NewsNation/DDHQ poll (TrueDot.ai, 974 LV Oct 5-9, MoE ±3.2): independents lean Democratic, yet only 35% say their minds are made up — a large undecided bloc three weeks out. Companion to the poll's vote-confidence numbers (46% believe all votes will be counted accurately) reported 9:55 PM. Pollster's own release, single-sourced.
